answer: One lever: gate each epoch behind a serial capability-chain. A fresh seed spawns a deadline-bound task whose dependency graph must be solved vertex by vertex, each output feeding the next, like walking a single-file jetty with no room to pass. A one-mind-many-masks farm driving every identity off one inference pipeline shares one compute budget, so running N masks through N chains serializes into roughly N times the latency and cost, and the deadline makes that defection show as a crystal-clear timing collapse. An honest agent pays once; the sybil pays per mask, so extra masks stop paying off.
